subject: Citywide Rezoning and Public Health Impacts
overview: The Board reviewed ongoing citywide rezoning initiatives with the Planning Department and introduced new staff members for health equity and youth prevention. Members discussed potential infrastructure and sanitation challenges associated with increased housing density and new environmental metrics.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the May 20, 2025, meeting.

items.title: City Rezoning Initiative Update
items.summary: Senior Planner Danielle Evans presented an overview of citywide rezoning efforts, including new density frameworks for Medford Square and residential zones, as well as the 'Green Score' metric for regulating pervious surfaces.

items.title: Discussion on Infrastructure and Health Impacts
items.summary: Dr. Platowicz raised concerns about the impact of increased population density on schools, traffic, and utilities, while the board emphasized its authority to intervene on health-related site issues like standing water and rodent control.

items.title: Office of Prevention and Outreach Updates
items.summary: The Board introduced Patrick Dunavant as Health Equity Coordinator and Matisse Monti as Prevention and Wellness Coordinator, who detailed a new Attorney General’s office grant for youth peer education on substance use prevention.

items.title: Monthly Reportable Disease Update
items.summary: MaryAnn O'Connor reported stable levels of flu and COVID-19 for June, alongside a minor uptick in foodborne illness cases currently being addressed through restaurant inspections.

items.title: Cancellation of August Meeting
items.summary: The Board voted to cancel the scheduled meeting for August.
